title: Mark Klein featured in Corporate Counsel
body_markdown:
General Counsel and Chief Administrative Officer[Mark Klein](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/mark-klein/) is the sole expert featured in a *Corporate Counsel* article entitled “Legal Departments Want to Shake ‘Cost Center’ Label But Unwittingly Reinforce the Perception.”


The article states: “In a recent interview with Law.com, Burford Capital General Counsel Mark Klein said improving the way in-house attorneys communicate with managers across the company also is central to recasting the legal department as a creator of value.”


[Click here to view full article.](https://www.law.com/corpcounsel/2024/03/20/legal-departments-want-to-shake-cost-center-label-but-they-unwittingly-reinforce-the-perception/)
